title: All 10 SAT Reading & Writing Question Types, Explained
description:
Every question in SAT Reading and Writing tests one of 10 official skills. Learn to spot each one from the question stem, the method that solves it, and the trap built into it. There's an SAT-style practice question for every type.

Covered, in the College Board's order:
• Craft and Structure: Words in Context, Text Structure and Purpose, Cross-Text Connections
• Information and Ideas: Central Ideas and Details, Command of Evidence (textual and quantitative), Inferences
• Standard English Conventions: Boundaries; Form, Structure, and Sense
• Expression of Ideas: Rhetorical Synthesis, Transitions
• A 4-step test-day method for any Reading and Writing question

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. Data in the table question is illustrative (made up for practice). For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank and filter by skill.
